# Tick Rest

> Tick Rest is a free, open-source macOS app that reminds you to rest your eyes, stretch, and take breaks throughout your day.

Tick Rest requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later and supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. The Windows version is in development and is not available to download yet.

The recommended installation method is Homebrew: `brew install --cask fthux/tap/tickrest`. The app is not Developer ID signed or notarized, so macOS may still require confirmation on first launch. Refer to the official website for installation guidance.

This file provides a guide to official project information. It does not grant additional rights to the software or website content, or define crawler or training permissions.

## Website

- [English website](https://tick-rest.fthux.com/): Features, screenshots, installation instructions, and frequently asked questions.
- [简体中文网站](https://tick-rest.fthux.com/zh-CN/): 功能介绍、真实截图、安装说明和常见问题。

- [macOS source code and README](https://github.com/fthux/tick-rest-macos): Official source repository and project documentation.
